name: QuantConnect Lean
what_it_holds: Open-source algo-trading engine with a committed Data/option/usa/{daily,hour,minute,universes} sample-data tree (small sample tickers, zip-of-CSV format `YYYYMMDD_tickType_optionType.zip`) used for local backtests, plus a paid QuantConnect Data Explorer for full historical US options chains. The free sample is a handful of tickers/dates for testing, not a broad historical panel.
why_useful: Could serve as a template/format for point-in-time option-chain storage if the team ever builds its own ABNB options history; the sample data itself is too thin (few tickers) to use directly for ABNB implied-move backtests.
size_hint: sample only, unknown exact row count
themes: Options and event-move tooling: historical option chains (CBOE samples, ORATS-like), earnings implied-move calculators, IV term-structure datasets, earnings-drift datasets
why_all: Could serve as a template/format for point-in-time option-chain storage if the team ever builds its own ABNB options history; the sample data itself is too thin (few tickers) to use directly for ABNB implied-move backtests.

name: GammaGrid
what_it_holds: Open-source dashboard (AGPL-3.0, 64 stars) computing dealer gamma exposure (GEX), max pain, open interest and an in-house-computed IV surface for a user's US-listed options watchlist, pulling from yfinance on a schedule; explicitly stores no historical dataset — users accumulate their own local history (~214 bytes/contract per snapshot) going forward only.
why_useful: Could be pointed at ABNB now and run through 5 Nov to build a homemade options-positioning/IV-surface time series into the print, but produces no retrospective history and duplicates the already-held Yahoo current-chain source.
size_hint: no committed data; per-snapshot local accumulation only
time_coverage: forward-only from whenever it is run
geography: US-listed options only (SPX/VIX index options excluded)
duplicate_of_holding: Yahoo current options chain already held
themes: Options and event-move tooling: historical option chains (CBOE samples, ORATS-like), earnings implied-move calculators, IV term-structure datasets, earnings-drift datasets
why_all: Could be pointed at ABNB now and run through 5 Nov to build a homemade options-positioning/IV-surface time series into the print, but produces no retrospective history and duplicates the already-held Yahoo current-chain source.

name: OptionMatrix
what_it_holds: GTK-based financial derivatives calculator implementing 171+ pricing models (Black-Scholes and many variants) for computing option prices, implied vol and greeks; 251 stars.
why_useful: Pure pricing/IV-calculation utility, not a data source; only marginally relevant as a fallback IV calculator if the team needs an offline pricer.
themes: Options and event-move tooling: historical option chains (CBOE samples, ORATS-like), earnings implied-move calculators, IV term-structure datasets, earnings-drift datasets
why_all: Pure pricing/IV-calculation utility, not a data source; only marginally relevant as a fallback IV calculator if the team needs an offline pricer.

name: option_tools
